desc:
Located just moments from downtown Stamford's bustling Bedford Street retail, restaurant and entertainment corridor, Bedford Hall is a luxury rental community boasting modern one and two bedroom residences. With a "walk score" of 95, you are truly in the center of it all. 

Bedford Hall features 12 expertly designed floor plans, from sleek junior 1 bedrooms to airy 2 bedroom apartments, finished with custom kitchens featuring top brand appliances, as well as sophisticated spa-like baths. The building boasts a collection of the finest amenities for your comfort and convenience- full-size stacked laundry in each unit, a state-of-the-art fitness center, billiards room, club lounge with kitchen, and rooftop lounge with fire pit and barbeque! 

Plus, enjoy on-site parking, a pet friendly and 100% smoke free athmosphere, and Wi-Fi throughout the building as well as in each unit. Contact our leasing team to schedule a private tour of this can't-miss building in Downtown Stamford!

desc:
Meet The Asher

Where evolved residential design and feature-forward apartments thoughtfully collide with luxury community amenities and a curated sense of place, smack dab in the center of Stamford. The Asher offers residents next-level living with architecturally distinctive apartment floor plans, unsurpassed amenities including: a private rooftop lounge and pool overlooking the city, coworking space, fully equipped fitness center, game rooms and much more, as well as unrivaled access to Stamford and Fairfield County.

desc:
Welcome to The Davenport, "a new classic". Built in 1915 by Robert Francis Adams and J. Hawley Ingalls as a hotel and completely remodeled and converted into luxury apartments by Empire Residential, LLC in 2023. The Davenport is a Stamford historical landmark.

The Davenport boasts 27 modern, elegant apartments in the heart of Downtown Stamford. All units are equipped with sleek, modern kitchens, elegant bathrooms with contemporary tile work and an overall classic yet modern aesthetic that is sure to please the most discerning taste. In unit laundry complete this Downtown oasis.

Community features include: modern elevator, control access, top of the line camera system and Amazon Lockers.

UCONN Stamford is a short walk away, as well as Mill River Park - home of the famous Alive At Five and various world class events throughout the year. Renowned area restaurants are mere feet away as well as the Stamford Town Center, Target, movie theater and more. Stamford Train Station (Metro North, Amtrak) is also within walking distance.

The Davenport is an apartment community located in Fairfield County and the 06901 ZIP Code. This area is served by the Stamford attendance zone.

desc: The Point Stamford offers studio, one, two and three-bedroom apartments in the heart of downtown Stamford, just a short walk from direct train service to New York City. Designed for those who want more from everyday living, this is where modern style, comfort, and convenience come together. Spend your afternoons by the heated pool, unwind in our courtyard retreat, or start your day with a coffee from our iconic lobby cafe. Inside your apartment, enjoy oversized windows that fill your space with natural light, an in-home washer and dryer, and thoughtfully selected finishes that elevate every detail. Plus, experience the benefits of having an onsite management and maintenance team who are there when you need them. Schedule a tour today and discover a community where connection, creativity, and comfort come together to make the everyday extraordinary.

desc:
Valeur Lofts is a brand new luxury apartment building featuring 41 modern loft residences within a landmark 1925 building in the heart of Columbus Park on Main Street. The units include 22 thoughtfully designed studios with efficient, open-concept layouts ideal for the modern professional and 19 spacious one-bedroom, one-bathroom residences with generous living areas. Every apartment includes an in-unit washer/ dryer, a modern kitchen with custom wood cabinetry, stainless steel appliances and stone countertops, oversized windows, central air conditioning, and keyless smart entry. The historic building features an art-deco lobby and hallways with arched ceilings, terra cotta tile, original doors and terrazzo floors. The building is steel-and-concrete construction, offering residents a quieter living experience. 24/7 private access fitness center. Pet-friendly. Walk Score 96. Located on the corner of Main and Atlantic, with immediate access to the restaurants and entertainment on Main and Summer Streets. A 10-minute walk to the MetroNorth Stamford Train Station with access to NYC.

NOW LEASING FOR DEC. 1st MOVE-IN.

desc:
Affordable luxury still exists in Stamford! Fabulous SMOKE-FREE, PET-FRIENDLY studio Apartment in Heart of Downtown Stamford. BEST VALUE AND LOCATION IN DOWNTOWN STAMFORD. 

Steps from Bedford, Atlantic & Summer St, Stamford Downtown's hot shopping and nightlife. Why worry about driving or finding an Uber when you can walk less than 1/2 block to everything you need - restaurants, nightspots, music festivals, movies, live theater. 
 SMOKE-FREE & PET FRIENDLY. Off-Street, designated parking space. Modern gourmet kitchen with full-size appliances - dishwasher, microwave, range, refrigerator. BIG closets. desc:
75 Tresser offers luxurious studio, one, two, and three-bedroom apartments with sleek and elegant finishes. From the moment you move in, you'll be surrounded by wood-style flooring, elevated nine-foot ceilings, panoramic windows, and in-unit washers and dryers. We even feature Juliette balconies, patios, and terraces on select apartments. In addition, from the moment you step outside your apartment, you'll be able to enjoy a vast array of amenities, including a community lounge area complete with billiards table, catering kitchen, conference room, technology center, and an impressive 5,000-square-foot fitness center and yoga studio.

Floor plans are artist's rendering. All dimensions are approximate. Actual product and specifications may vary in dimension or detail. Not all features are available in every rental home. Please see a representative for details.

desc:
Discover the art of luxurious living at Atlantic Station, an extraordinary apartment community nestled in the vibrant heart of Stamford, CT. Offering a curated selection of studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom residences, each home boasts expansive windows, elegant finishes, and premium stainless-steel appliances. Designed with meticulous attention to detail, Atlantic Station blends contemporary style with unparalleled comfort. Enjoy an array of upscale amenities, including a sparkling pool, all within an atmosphere of refined sophistication. Ideally situated near downtown's dynamic dining, shopping, and waterfront, and with convenient transit access, this is where elevated living meets ultimate convenience.

This information is a general overview of potential costs. For a complete list of fees, visit our property website. Prices are subject to change and may vary based on move-in date and lease term. Some apartment homes may require prequalification if required by any applicable affordability program. Standard security deposit subject to change based on screening results; total security deposit(s) will not exceed any maximum prescribed by applicable law. Resident may be responsible for maintaining insurance or covering related costs. Some fees may not apply to apartment homes receiving subsidies or subject to an affordability program. Resident is responsible for damages that exceed ordinary wear and tear. Some items may be taxed under applicable law. This form does not modify the lease, and all fees are subject to the lease. Additional fees may apply as detailed in the lease. A sample lease may be requested prior to application. Residents may be responsible for utilities and related fees, per the lease. Lease terms and available options are subject to change and may vary based on apartment home availability and any applicable program requirements. In the event of any informational conflict, the lease governs.

Bedford Creative brings boutique apartment living to Downtown Stamford with modern finishes, thoughtful amenities, and a flexible live/work lifestyle. This residence includes one-bedroom apartments and Dual Space One-Bedrooms, a two-space unit concept with a private apartment and a separate flex space across the hall.Each residence features open concept layouts, oversized windows, and contemporary kitchens with Energy Star stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, and custom cabinetry. desc:
Exquisitely finished yet infinitely comfortable, every detail at The Stanley has been designed and built to envelop you with the sophisticated comforts of home. Our sleekly styled studio and one-bedroom apartment homes surround you with modern stainless steel and quartz kitchens, wood-grain style plank flooring, high ceilings and banks of windows to let in natural light and beautiful city views. When not in your apartment, enjoy our large fitness center and laundry care centers on each floor.

Step out of The Stanley's front doors RIGHT into Downtown Stamford's exciting urban center - enjoy a cup of joe at one of Stamford's many friendly coffee shops, enjoy a movie, live concert, festival or just a quiet dinner under the stars. All without needing a car, Uber or public transportation. Although those options are all easily accessible from The Stanley should you need them.

And what home would be complete without your best furry friend? We welcome up to 2 cats or a small dog. And they will love all of Stamford's many pet-friendly parks and hikes.

To schedule a tour, submit an Application for Rental on the GHMCO website. A $13 credit check fee will be taken at the time of submission. Once your Application has been received, our friendly leasing staff will contact you to set up an appointment. Zillow applications are not accepted.

We look forward to welcoming you to The Stanley!

desc: Welcome home to 101 Park Place in Stamford, CT. Just ten minutes from Downtown, and with easy access to I-95, 101 Park Place at Harbor Point is close to many exciting attractions in Stamford, CT. Perfectly situated near everything you need and want, we're in close proximity to some of the best shopping, dining, and entertainment options our city has to offer. The University of Connecticut is close by as well. Thoughtfully designed with you in mind, these Stamford apartments for rent have premium amenities. Each one or two bedroom apartment is detailed with beautiful hardwood floors and high ceilings. Choose from thirteen floor plans, with inviting features like granite countertops, a breakfast nook, and custom cabinetry. Living space increases with a balcony or patio where you can enjoy the views, and cooking is fun again in your gourmet kitchen with energy star stainless steel appliances!

Located in the heart of Harbor Point's historic Yale & Towne District, Vault Apartments offers a distinctive urban lifestyle just steps from the Stamford Train Station and within walking distance of premier shopping, dining, and entertainment. This smoke-free community combines modern luxury with exceptional convenience, featuring a resort-style heated pool, fire pits, BBQ pavilions, a 24-hour fitness center, dog park, and reserved garage parking.

Thoughtfully designed apartment homes showcase upscale finishes including stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, hardwood-style flooring, kitchen islands, spacious walk-in closets, private balconies, and stunning views. Centrally located in Stamford, Vault Apartments is minutes from award-winning parks, top-rated schools, cultural attractions, and endless dining and shopping opportunities. Discover why Vault is one of Harbor Point's most desirable places to call home.

Welcome to Riverhouse Stamford, all the convenience of downtown, without all the noise! Riverhouse residents live directly across from beautiful Mill River Park home to concerts, sunrise yoga, Bark Park, farmers markets, seasonal ice skating, and the popular Hey Stamford Food Festival while being just minutes from Downtown Stamford (10 min walk) Metro-North (16 min walk), Stamford Hospital (14 min walk) UConn(10 min walk) dining, shopping, and easy I-95 access (2 min drive). At Riverhouse, you'll sleep easy with Mill River Park right at your doorstep set back from the congestion of downtown, yet connected to it all.

Riverhouse Highlights:
 Extremely spacious loft like studio suites that live like 1 beds!
 One of Stamford's largest rooftop decks with Jacuzzis,outdoor showers and coming soon gorgeous large outdoor grill!
 1,575 sq ft state-of-the-art fitness center!
 Select residences feature private balconies overlooking the park!
 Posh dog spa + dog-friendly living! Dog trails at your doorstep & Bark Park close by.
 Facial recognition entry system!
 Sip & More coffee station in a stylish lobby
 Amazon package hub with refrigeration + dry cleaning pick-up/drop-off
 Resident lounge & business center with park views!

Our studios are truly spacious and live like 1 bedrooms. All apartments from the studios to 1-bedroom & 2-bedroom residences feature stylish modern kitchens and baths, in-unit washer/dryers, and upscale finishes throughout. The sleek Kitchen cabinets come in both gray and white finishes.

desc:
At TGM Anchor Point, you'll be minutes from all Stamford has to offer, but far away from the ordinary. The waterfront lifestyle you deserve awaits you. Come home to TGM Anchor Point.

Enjoy our newly renovated state-of-the-art 2-level athletic club with Matrix Series 7xi equipment, resort style outdoor swimming pool facing the harbor, and indoor basketball and racquetball courts. Relax in the cafe lounge with fresh coffee and complementary Wi-Fi or take a walk on our scenic boardwalk overlooking Stamford harbor. 

Interested in boating? You're only a few steps from TGM Anchor Point Marina, which offers 72 deep water boat slips for seasonal and transient rental with convenient access to the LI Sound.

Walk along the boardwalk and enjoy all of the restaurants Stamford Harbor has to offer. Enjoying an upscale, waterfront lifestyle has never been easier.

With easy access to I-95, and the Stamford train station you're less than an hour from Manhattan. Don't worry about parking at the train station; residents enjoy a shuttle service to the station making for a hassle-free commute.

No amenity fees, broker fees, or hidden fees plus water, trash, and a free gym membership are included. Residents also enjoy a free grilling/lounge area, 2 on-site dog runs, and plenty of parking. Every apartment includes 1 free parking space! with covered parking available for $95/month and a second assigned outdoor space for just $75 + tax.

Just minutes from downtown restaurants, bars, shopping, and nightlife, yet set back enough from the 24/7 noise. Conveniently located near fitness centers, supermarkets, CVS, nail salons, and the mall.

Utilities: Tenants pay heat, gas, and electric in most apartments.

Pet Policy: $50/month pet fee. 1 dog and up to 2 cats permitted. Two small dogs or larger dogs may be considered case by case. Breed and size restrictions apply.

desc:
Discover The Lafayette, a modern apartment community in the heart of Stamford, CT, near Downtown, Harbor Point, and the Metro-North train station. Built in 2024, The Lafayette offers residents a seamless connection to shopping, dining, entertainment, and commuter routes.

Choose from bright studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments, each featuring modern finishes, smart building access, and turn-key Wi-Fi. Enjoy standout amenities including a 9,000 sq. ft. rooftop garden with BBQ and lounge seating, a 2,800 sq. ft. fitness center with indoor and outdoor workout zones, a game lounge, and a communal workspace.

The Lafayette blends modern design with everyday convenience, an affordable yet elevated place to call home in Stamford.

Come to Harbor Landing to find apartments for rent in Stamford CT. Select a new studio, 1 bedroom or 2 bedroom Stamford Apartments for you and your pet. Finding a luxury Stamford apartment is easy with numerous apartments in unique Harbor Landing. Enjoy amenities, ranging from a community club room, sundeck with resort style pool, and fitness center.

Floor plans are artist's rendering. All dimensions are approximate. Actual product and specifications may vary in dimension or detail. Not all features are available in every rental home. Please see a representative for details.

Your future begins here at 121 Towne Apartments.

desc: Welcome to The Westcott, the trifecta of affordable luxury living in Stamford, Connecticut. Our all-inclusive amenities, spacious suites, and perfect location near all the action make us the ideal place to call home. We offer studio, one, two, and three-bedroom units with expansive windows, roomy closets, all-electric kitchens, private balconies, and access to our private, indoor swimming pool and jacuzzi, outdoor basketball court, clubhouse with billiards, and on-site movie theater. Our fully stocked fitness center and private, scenic area for picnics and barbecues are sure to make you feel right at home. Our staff is on-call to take care of your maintenance needs and we are pet-friendly as well. The Westcott is conveniently located next to amazing shops, scenic parks and trails, and many nearby eateries. You will find that our location lets you easily access nearby schools, parks, stadiums, restaurants, shops, and more. Welcome to The Westcott: the best move you'll ever make!

desc:
Looking for that perfect location in the Springdale area of Stamford? The Art Deco State Theater Building is centrally located to all your needs! Less than a 5-minute walk to the Metro-North Springdale Station. Right on a major bus line on Hope Street to downtown Stamford. Springdale has its own traditional downtown area, mostly along Hope Street. Other neighborhood amenities include coffee shops, restaurants, professional offices, laundromats, banks, and a variety of small, locally owned shops. The Weed Branch of the city library system is located two blocks north on Hope Street. Nearby is the Springdale Little League baseball field, one of Connecticut's premier Little League fields. The neighborhood is served by Springdale Elementary School, Dolan Middle School, and Stamford High School. 

12-month initial lease term. Landlord provides cold water, hot water, sewer, trash and recycling, snow removal, Tenant responsible for gas for heat and cooking, plus electric for outlets/appliances. Pet Friendly: up to 2 cats OR 1 dog (under 50lbs, non-aggressive breeds) OR 1 cat and 1 dog. Restrictions and fees apply. See GHMCO website for full pet policy. A $13 credit check fee (soft inquiry) will be taken electronically at the time of application. To set up a tour, please submit an Application for Rental on the GHMCO website. Once received, our friendly leasing staff will contact you. Please note that Zillow applications are not accepted.

desc:
Enjoy all the benefits of what The New York Times called "a small town in a high rise city." Springdale's gem, 1032 Hope Street Apartments, features sophisticated details and large windows to soak in the sunlight, sleekly styled apartment homes designed for comfort and satisfaction. 

Test out your favorite new recipe in your modern, fully equipped kitchen. Wood-grain tile plank flooring looks spectacular and cleans up even easier! When not in your apartment, grab a cuppa coffee from one of many Springdale neighborhood shops and enjoy it in 1032 Hope Street's lovely and comfortable resident lounge, looking out on friendly Hope Street. So many highly rated dining options are right out your door! Walk to Ferguson Library Weed Hill Branch, Twin Rinks, Springdale Elementary School, great restaurants, shopping and services right from 1032 Hope's front door. 

Want more shopping or nightlife? Downtown Stamford's exciting urban center is a short drive by car, or jump on a city bus across the street and leave the driving to them! Stamford's bustling city center features the Stamford Towne Center Shopping Mall, Palace Theater, Mill River & Scalzi Parks, and of course, the city's three municipal beaches. 

Metro North's Springdale Station is a quick 5 minute walk south on Hope Street. Connect to downtown Stamford, New York City, and points north in CT & along the New England coastline.

Feeling like staying home? Enjoy the Community Room's comfortable couches, free Wi-Fi and big screen TV or the latest in fitness equipment in our Exercise Room. SMOKE FREE. 

And what home would be complete without your best furry friend? We welcome up to 2 cats or one dog 50lbs. And they will love all of Stamford's many pet-friendly parks and hikes (See GHMCO for full pet policy.) 

SUBMIT AN APPLICATION on the GHMCO website. Once received, our friendly leasing staff will contact you to schedule a tour. A credit check fee of $13 will be collected electronically at the time of application.

desc: Experience elevated city meets coastal living at SoNo 19Day in South Norwalk, CT. This boutique luxury community offers a curated lifestyle with premier amenities: a rooftop terrace with panoramic skyline views, putting green, lounge chairs and grilling stations. Enjoy a state-of-the-art fitness center, a stylish business lounge, secure bike storage with a repair station, and a pet washing station for your four-legged companions. Located in the vibrant SoNo neighborhood, you're steps from waterfront dining, trendy shops, cultural attractions, and the South Norwalk Metro North station, providing seamless access to the city. Residents also enjoy exclusive perks like free beach access to Calf Pasture and Shady Beach, perfect for leisurely weekends or sunset strolls along the coast. For those who value comfort, convenience, and a touch of sophistication, SoNo 19Day delivers a lifestyle where modern luxury meets coastal charm.

APPLY BY 11/15/26 TO RECEIVE $1000 OFF FIRST FULL MONTH RENT WITH A 12+ LEASE!

The Sheffield SoNo is a pet-friendly apartment community in South Norwalk, Connecticut near I-95, the Metro-North and Route 7. All great stories need the perfect setting. Your story begins at The Sheffield SoNo, a modern waterfront apartment community combining stylish living with the charm of South Norwalk. The Sheffield's 136 residences boast generous 1-bedroom and 2-bedroom luxury apartment floor plans. It is hard to choose which view is better - the one out your window or the inside with a modern design and stylish apartment features, which include hardwood cabinets, stone granite counters, full-sized washer/dryers and stainless steel appliances. Ask about select units with walk-in closets and private balcony/terraces.

Everywhere in vibrant South Norwalk (SoNo) is walkable. When at The Sheffield SoNo, you enjoy direct access to all of your favorite places no matter how you choose to get there - foot, car or boat; this includes being in the city that never sleeps in the blink of an eye. Residents have convenient shopping, dining and entertainment moments away at The SoNo Collection. The Sheffield SoNo is close to major employers and schools such as Xerox, EMCOR Group, Synchrony Financial, Booking Holdings, Charter Communications, Bridgeport Hospital, University of Connecticut Stamford (UCONN), Fairfield University and Norwalk Public Schools. Nearby South Norwalk Metro-North Station, I-95 and Route 7 provide easy access to downtown New York City, Stamford, Bridgeport and the greater tri-state area.

With a 24-hour fitness center you can jump start the day or ease into night. Night owls also have access to a clubhouse and business center that never close. Who needs a bedtime story when you can have a conference call instead? Whether you are looking to relax or stay active, our community amenities are luxurious and convenient: a heated swimming pool, a poolside patio with BBQ grilling

desc:
Welcome to SONO Pearl, where harbor views meet the best of South Norwalk living. This 66-unit building offers one and two bedroom apartments in one of Connecticut's most walkable, waterfront-adjacent neighborhoods and honestly, the location alone is hard to beat.

Inside, you'll find kitchens outfitted with top-brand appliances and designer fixtures, spacious closets, stylish bathrooms, and your own in-unit washer and dryer no more hauling laundry down the hall.

Step outside and you're just minutes from marinas, kayaking, and the Norwalk Islands, plus 40+ restaurants, a 6-screen movie theater, and the Maritime Aquarium's IMAX theater. The South Norwalk train station is an easy walk away, so commuting into the city is no hassle at all.

What you'll love about living here:
On-site garage parking
Friendly, in-house management
A rooftop garden and lounge with sweeping coastal views
A resident lounge with WiFi great for working from "home"
A peaceful Zen garden to unwind in
In-unit washer/dryer
Pet friendly (bring the whole family)
100% smoke-free building

desc: The Confluence at Norwalk Apartments brings together modern design, everyday comfort, and the best of waterfront living in the heart of downtown. Located along the Norwalk River, our community has spacious apartment homes in a range of renovated and classic styles, all with open layouts, charming views, and quality finishes.Enjoy resort-style community amenities and services that support a connected, flexible routine. From furnished homes and short-term leases to curated resident events, every detail here supports the way you live: modern, connected, and effortless.Close to SoNos restaurants, shops, and entertainment, with easy access to the Metro-North station, you can enjoy everything Fairfield County has to offer from the comfort of our well-located and thoughtfully designed apartments in Norwalk, CT.

sets, with access to an on-site laundry care center available for all residents.
Residents at Soundview Apartments enjoy a peaceful, well-maintained community with beautifully landscaped grounds, controlled-access entryways, ample on-site parking, and responsive 24-hour maintenance service. Its central location makes commuting and travel throughout Fairfield County simple and convenient.
Community amenities include:
 	Resident-controlled heat, hot water, and air conditioning 
 	In-unit washer and dryers in select residences 
 	On-site laundry care center 
 	Ample on-site parking 
 	Controlled-access building entry 
 	Beautifully maintained landscaping and grounds 
 	24-hour emergency maintenance service 
A monthly $40 service fee includes cold water, trash removal, and recycling services.

desc:
Experience luxury redefined at Scribe, a thoughtfully designed apartment community in the heart of Norwalk's vibrant West Avenue district. With 204 beautifully crafted residences and a remarkable collection of amenities rarely found in buildings of this size, Scribe offers the scale and sophistication of a premier propertywithout the crowds. From expansive social spaces to quiet corners to unwind, Scribe gives you the space to live well, breathe easy, and feel truly at home.

Inside each home, residents enjoy spacious layouts with soaring ceilings, expansive windows for natural light, custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, and walk-in closets. Select residences feature double vanities and lofted ceilings for added comfort and style.

Beyond the front door, Scribe impresses with oversized amenities that elevate everyday livingan expansive pool deck with cabanas and firepits, a state-of-the-art fitness center with a yoga studio and virtual training, coworking suites with private pods and quiet zones, and a vibrant resident lounge with game tables and entertainment space. From the dog spa to the kid's playroom, every detail is curated for modern comfort.

desc:
6 Elm Street Apartments Norwalk, CT

Welcome to 6 Elm Street, a well-maintained apartment community conveniently located in Central Norwalk. This 12-unit property offers a variety of thoughtfully designed 1- and 2-bedroom apartments, providing comfortable living spaces in a convenient location.

Many apartments feature hardwood flooring, updated kitchens with ample cabinetry and full-size appliances, and select units offer in-unit laundry and air conditioning. The property also offers off-street parking and a comfortable residential setting.

Located just minutes from downtown Norwalk and South Norwalk, residents enjoy easy access to shopping, restaurants, entertainment, parks, public transportation, and major roadways. With its convenient location and variety of apartment layouts, 6 Elm Street is a great place to call home.

Property Features:

12-unit apartment community
1- and 2-bedroom apartments
Hardwood flooring in select units
Updated kitchens
Full-size appliances
Select units with in-unit washer & dryer
Select units with air conditioning
Off-street parking
Convenient Central Norwalk location
Close to shopping, dining, entertainment, and transportation

Contact us today to learn about current availability and schedule a private tour.

desc:
Piper, a new upscale living destination, redefining contemporary living in Norwalk, Connecticut. Located along the West Avenue corridor, Piper offers sophisticated apartments with high-end finishes and thoughtfully designed amenities. Residents will enjoy easy access to The Block's vibrant dining scene, local culture at the Norwalk Art Space, the historic Lockwood Mathews Mansion Museum, and the green spaces of Matthews Park. With convenient access to I-95, Piper provides a seamless blend of refined living and connected community life.

This information is a general overview of potential costs. For a complete list of fees, visit our property website. Prices are subject to change and may vary based on move-in date and lease term. Some apartment homes may require prequalification if required by any applicable affordability program. Standard security deposit subject to change based on screening results; total security deposit(s) will not exceed any maximum prescribed by applicable law. Resident may be responsible for maintaining insurance or covering related costs. Some fees may not apply to apartment homes receiving subsidies or subject to an affordability program. Resident is responsible for damages that exceed ordinary wear and tear. Some items may be taxed under applicable law. This form does not modify the lease, and all fees are subject to the lease. Additional fees may apply as detailed in the lease. A sample lease may be requested prior to application. Residents may be responsible for utilities and related fees, per the lease. Lease terms and available options are subject to change and may vary based on apartment home availability and any applicable program requirements. In the event of any informational conflict, the lease governs.

desc:
Modern Living at The Flats at 289 Main Ave
Looking for a fresh start in a prime location? Discover your new home at The Flats at 289 Main Ave, Norwalk. This fully updated studio offers the perfect blend of modern style and ultimate convenience.

The Space
Experience a "new home" feel with high-end finishes and a clean, minimalist aesthetic:

Freshly Renovated: Brand new flooring, sleek countertops, and modern cabinetry throughout.

Crisp Interior: Professional fresh paint provides a bright, inviting atmosphere.

Fully Equipped: Includes a refrigerator, electric stove, and a dedicated AC unit to keep you cool.

Efficient Living: Reliable electric heating in a layout designed for easy maintenance.

Building & Amenities
Enjoy the perks of a building designed for effortless living:

On-Site Laundry: Clean and convenient laundry facilities right in the building no more trips to the laundromat.

Dual Parking Options: Includes access to a covered parking area for weather protection and a spacious rear parking lot.

The Location: Everything at Your Fingertips
Located in the heart of Norwalk, you are minutes away from the best the area has to offer:

Commuter's Dream: Instant access to Route 15 (Merritt Parkway) and I-95, making your commute as smooth as possible.

Shop & Dine: Close proximity to local shopping centers, grocery stores, and popular Norwalk dining spots.

desc: The Beacon offers a peaceful balance of tranquility and connection. Just off of Westport Ave, you can enjoy easy commutes and access to all the wonderful shopping and dining that the charming Fairfield County is known for. Yet, nestled back amongst the trees, away from roads, each home is a sanctuary of natural beauty. Destress from your day on the rooftop lounge, hanging out poolside, meditating in the yoga room, or walking through 2 acres of dedicated conservation area along the community. The Beacon's suite of amenities gives you plenty of social spaces and quiet places to unwind. Whether you'd rather indulge in a night in or experience the town, this is the perfect home base for the lifestyle you crave. Conveniences like the electric car charging stations and onsite dog park and pet spa make life uncomplicated. Modern interiors with designer finishes elevate every apartment home without excess, creating an attainable level of comfort and luxury unparalleled in the surrounding area. This is the life you deserve.

Lease terms and available options are subject to change and may vary based on apartment home availability and any applicable program requirements. In the event of any informational conflict, the lease governs.

desc:
Tucked along the winding shores of Ash Creek, Canfield Park at Fairfield Metro is just 0.5 miles from Fairfield-Black Rock Metro Train Station, with express rides to and from NYC and Stamford. Head a few blocks in the other direction on foot or by bike, and find yourself in the heart of Black Rock, with its charming coffee shops, fabled restaurants, bars and more. While at home, enjoy gourmet kitchens, spa-like baths, sprawling living spaces and amazing amenities like a sparkling swimming pool with cabanas, premium fitness center and gorgeous outdoor spaces. Start enjoying the luxury lifestyle today at Canfield Park! Some photos may have been virtually staged to show furnishing potential. 
 Approval Standards: Where applicable, approvals are based on the gross rent, not the net effective rent.

desc:
SPECIAL DEAL: One month FREE in rent credit on any new 12 month lease! 

Welcome to RockRidge Place, a newly and fully renovated pet-friendly community offering modern luxury living. RockRidge Place is comprised of one three-story building featuring one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments, as well as outdoor amenities such as a pet play area and a community grilling and patio area. 

Each apartment is designed with an open-concept floor plan and contemporary finishes, including stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, shaker-style kitchen cabinets, engineered hardwood flooring, and recessed lighting. Enjoy the convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer, as well as in-wall A/C units. Ample outdoor lighting and a security system have been added to enhance safety. 

RockRidge Place is located less than five minutes from downtown Fairfield, with the convenience of easy access to shopping, dining, and entertainment. As part of our comprehensive living experience, the $125 monthly community fee for essential services such as heat, hot water, trash removal, Renters Insurance, Resident reward program, and credit building making it easier to manage your monthly expenses.

Our attentive, full-time on-site team and convenient online resident portal ensure that maintenance requests are handled promptly and effectively, with the added convenience of easy online payments.

We hope to have you join us soon!

Located in a quiet, walkable area near shops, restaurants, and public transportation, 141 Andover is perfect for those seeking modern living in a connected community.

desc:
The art of living at The August. Life unlimited - live the way you've always wanted at The August.

Inspired by the romantic realism of 19th-century painter Francis Augustus Silva, our community is where art, elegance, and everyday life come together in a striking composition.Nestled along the glistening edge of Steelpointe Harbor, The August invites you to start and end your days with panoramic sunsets that blur the line between canvas and reality. Here, golden skies melt into deep harbor blues, creating a daily masterpiece that makes coming home feel like stepping into a work of art.Our expansive pool is more than a place to unwind. It is a serene oasis surrounded by thoughtful design and subtle luxury. Whether you're lounging under sunlit skies or gathering with friends for twilight swims, every moment is painted in the colors of leisure and calm.And when the city calls, Manhattan is only a short train ride away. At The August, you're perfectly positioned between the vibrant energy of New York City and the tranquil charm of the harborfront, giving you access to both bold ambition and peaceful retreat.Inside, our apartment residences are crafted for those who appreciate the finer strokes of modern living. This initiative expands access to exceptional waterfront living while maintaining the elevated design, premium amenities, and vibrant lifestyle that define our community. Eligibility requirements apply. Enjoy the life you deserve. At The August, your home is more than an address. It is a gallery of experience, a curated lifestyle, and a timeless escape. Welcome to waterfront living, reimagined as art.

desc: Nestled in the heart of Fairfield's Mill River Valley, 5545 Park Fairfield offers a unique balance of luxury apartment living and modern amenities in natural surroundings for a comfortable and convenient living experience. Enjoy a peaceful retreat within walking distance of Sacred Heart University and Fairchild Wheeler Golf Course while only and minutes away from the Trumbull Mall and nearby shops, amenities and entertainment options. Commute effortlessly via nearby routes or work from home with ease. Each spacious, fully-appointed studio, 1-bedroom or 2-bedroom unit includes views of the Mill River Valley, Sacred Heart University campus, sunrises or sunsets. All units have modern fit and finishes with quartz countertops, custom kitchen cabinetry, stainless-steel energy-efficient appliances, in-unit washers and dryers, hardwood plank style flooring, 1 or 2 full bathrooms with tile and glass-door finishes and LED lighting throughout. Most units have 1 or 2 dens/offices, a outdoor deck or Juliet balcony. Relax in one of several lounges and co-working spaces located on each floor, including our signature rooftop lounge and terrace offering stunning vistas and sunset views. A state-of-the-art gym, 24 secure indoor and climate-controlled storage units, 8 electric vehicle charging stations, complimentary lounge WiFi and mail and package rooms make for a complete and convenient amenity experience. Pet friendly.

desc:
Modern apartment living at 1645 Black Rock Turnpike in Fairfield, CT. Built in 2019, this professionally managed building offers bright, clean studio and one-bedroom apartments ranging from $1,900 to $2,400, with furnished and short-term options available for a premium.

Units feature granite countertops, white shaker cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and energy-efficient systems. Open layouts create comfortable, airy living spaces with room to relax, work, and dine. The building is pre-wired for high-speed internet (Optimum & Frontier).

Ownership covers natural gas (hot water), water, sewer, trash, snow removal, and exterior maintenance. Tenants are responsible for electricity, cable/internet, and liability insurance. One off-street parking space is included, with additional parking available for $25/month.

Amenities include an elevator, on-site laundry, and on-site property management. Conveniently located within walking distance to shops, restaurants, and public transportation, with easy access to I-95, the Merritt Parkway, and a short drive to the Fairfield Metro train station.

Call us today to schedule your personalized tour.

desc:
Nestled along the scenic banks of the Still River and overlooking beautiful foliage of Danbury, CT, you'll find The Point at Still River. Here, you'll discover some of the most spacious and well-kept apartment homes in Fairfield County. Our thoughtfully designed apartments offer spacious one-, two- and three-bedroom floor plans fully equipped with gourmet kitchens, central heating and air conditioning, washers and dryers in every home, patios and stunning bay windows. Perfectly placed amenities include a state-of-the-art fitness center, swimming pool and landscaped grounds with picnic and barbecue areas.

This information is a general overview of potential costs. For a complete list of fees, visit our property website. Prices are subject to change and may vary based on move-in date and lease term. Some apartment homes may require prequalification if required by any applicable affordability program. Standard security deposit subject to change based on screening results; total security deposit(s) will not exceed any maximum prescribed by applicable law. Resident may be responsible for maintaining insurance or covering related costs. Some fees may not apply to apartment homes receiving subsidies or subject to an affordability program. Resident is responsible for damages that exceed ordinary wear and tear. Some items may be taxed under applicable law. This form does not modify the lease, and all fees are subject to the lease. Additional fees may apply as detailed in the lease. A sample lease may be requested prior to application. Residents may be responsible for utilities and related fees, per the lease. Lease terms and available options are subject to change and may vary based on apartment home availability and any applicable program requirements. In the event of any informational conflict, the lease governs.

desc:
Welcome to Oasis Apartments

A place where you can slow down, breathe, and truly feel at home.

Life moves fast. Home shouldn't.

Tucked inside a beautifully designed gated community, Oasis Apartments offers a rare combination of modern living, thoughtful amenities, and a welcoming neighborhood atmosphere all just minutes from Bridgeport Hospital and a short drive to Stratford, Fairfield, New Haven, Norwalk, and beyond.

Whether you're coming home after a long shift, working remotely with lightning-fast fiber internet, or watching your children play while your dog enjoys the park, Oasis was designed around the way people actually live.

Imagine coming home after a long day to a quiet community where you can work out, walk your dog, watch your kids play, or simply relax by the koi pond.

Every apartment is thoughtfully finished with quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, an in-unit washer and dryer, and individually controlled heating and air conditioning, giving you the comfort and convenience you deserve from the moment you walk through the door.

Step outside and discover a community built for everyday living:

 Beautiful resident lobby
 State-of-the-art fitness center
 Resident clubhouse and lounge
 Children's playground
 Pickleball court
 Basketball court
 Dog park
 Peaceful koi pond
 Outdoor grilling and picnic areas
 Secure gated access

Oasis isn't a crowded high-rise where you're just another apartment number. It's a place where neighbors become familiar faces, where children have room to play, where professionals can recharge after a demanding day, and where every detail was designed to make coming home the best part of your day.

If you've been searching for a home that offers modern finishes, outstanding amenities, and exceptional value without sacrificing comfort or convenience, you'll find it here.

The best way to experience Oasis is to see it in person. Schedule your private tour today and discover why so many residents are choosing Oasis.

desc:
Star Deluxe Milford - A Metro Star Community - Find your place with us!

Nobody loves Milford more than Metro Star! Defined by nine residential buildings and a clubhouse, Star Deluxe Milford is its own village, offering an exciting lifestyle just minutes from downtown Milford.

Tenants can enjoy the spacious clubhouse with a fireplace, common areas with high-speed wi-fi, and a cozy lounge for relaxing and socializing. Staying fit is easy with access to the two-level, state-of-the-art fitness center. Courtyards with dining and barbeques, on-site leasing office, optional covered parking, extra storage, package room, and car charging stations complete the well-designed community of Star Deluxe Milford.

Star Deluxe Milford is conveniently located on the western corridor of US 1 with easy access to 95. Only 1.3 miles from vibrant downtown Milford and the Metro North Train, there are options galore within close proximity including groceries, hair and nail salon, florist, and restaurants.

The floor plan options include studio, one-bedroom, one-bedroom plus, two-bedroom, and townhouse units. Abundant windows bring natural light to the apartment's stainless and quartz kitchens while ample closet space and in-unit washer/dryer complete the wish list of most renters. Beautiful wood simulated floors and tile baths offer the perfect mix of comfort and luxury.

Star Deluxe Milford welcomes furry friends with pet-friendly options and a designated play area.

desc:
CRAFTED FOR CONNECTICUT LIVING

Whether it's the cheerful spaces in our clubroom, the abundant amenities or our landscaped grounds, once you've arrived in our neighborhood, you're immediately at ease. Our refined apartment homes follow suit. Whether you select a traditional floor plan or a townhome with direct entry, you'll love the spacious layouts and stylish finishes. The best part? Every corner of every building at Woodside has been crafted for this land, for this time, for how you want to live now.

Floor plans are artist's rendering. All dimensions are approximate. Actual product and specifications may vary in dimension or detail. Not all features are available in every rental home. Please see a representative for details.

desc: Located in charming Trumbull, Connecticut, The Residences at Main is a new gated community of luxurious rental residences designed to offer pedestrian connectivity to the restaurants, shops and services at the nearby Trumbull Mall. Featuring spaciously designed and beautifully appointed one- and two-bedroom apartment homes, The Residences at Main is situated on Trumbullas historic Main Street just minutes from Beach Memorial Park, Tashua Knolls Golf Course, and the century-old Plaskoas Farm and Creamery. The Residences at Main provides a relaxed recreational lifestyle with amenities that include an outdoor heated pool with sundeck, residentsa lounge, state-of-the-art fitness center, dog park, resident parking, and EV charging stations. Residents also enjoy the unsurpassed convenience of the Merritt Parkway, I-95 and nearby Metro-North stations. Considered one of the top 20 towns in America, Trumbull boasts a public school system that is ranked #4 in the state. Welcome to The Residences at Main - where past and present live in harmony in historic Trumbull.

desc:
Metro on Broad - A home where stories begin.

A landmark piece, Metro on Broad captures the essence of coastal living while, at the same time, preserving history and the majestic landscape of the town green. This tastefully designed community is one of the latest additions to Milford's exceptional quality apartment living for the downtown Milford area. The site of Simon Lake's submarine development, this community honors the first submarine to operate in the open sea. His long time home proudly stands on the property and Metro Star is honored to share his incredible story and love of the sea as depicted throughout this aesthetically pleasing community featuring bold architecture and hand-picked, nautically influenced, artwork.

Always a cut above the rest, Metro Star has added special touches that combine quintessential New England charm with a nautical flare. Take a stroll around the cobblestone paths that connect the beautifully designed buildings where you will be surrounded by gorgeous plantings, park benches, and a stunning courtyard. The majestic clock tower will chime with the pride and passion that Metro Star has for the City of Milford.

Our pet friendly apartments have refined interiors with gracious layouts that include stainless appliances, quartz counters, luxury plank flooring, and in-unit laundry. With the added bonuses of a state-of-the-art fitness center and secure garage parking, Metro on Broad presents an irresistible living experience.

Tap into a vibrant lifestyle while connecting to all downtown Milford has to offer. Metro on Broad is your luxury yacht in the heart of downtown with phenomenal amenities that will fill your days with comfort, class, and convenience.

Welcome to Franklin School Lofts Historic Charm Meets Modern Luxury!
Experience the perfect blend of unique architectural history and upscale modern living at Franklin School Lofts, located at 50 Derby Avenue. Originally a classic, iconic brick schoolhouse, this building has been beautifully transformed into stunning loft-style apartments featuring a freshly updated exterior and high-end interior finishes.

Whether you are looking for a cozy 1-bedroom or a spacious 2-bedroom layout, our multiple floor plans offer an airy, bright, and character-rich environment you won't find in a standard apartment complex.

The Home You'll Love
Step inside to find a chef-inspired kitchen fully equipped with brand-new white cabinetry and gleaming quartz countertops. Beautiful architectural details like exposed brick or soaring ceilings pair perfectly with premium modern comforts. Most units come fully equipped with central air conditioning and efficient natural gas heat to keep you comfortable year-round.

Building Features & Amenities:
Historic Conversion: Stunning, iconic brick exterior with recent modern updates.

Premium Kitchens: Brand-new cabinets and sparkling quartz countertops.

Diverse Layouts: A variety of 1-bedroom and 2-bedroom floor plans to choose from.

On-Site Laundry: Convenient laundry facilities located right in the building.

Stress-Free Parking: Ample off-street parking for residents and guests.

Pet-Friendly: We welcome your furry friends! (Inquire about pet policies).

Unbeatable Commuter Location
Nestled in a vibrant Derby neighborhood, Franklin School Lofts is a commuter's dream. Enjoy super quick and easy access to Route 34 and Route 8, putting New Haven, Bridgeport, Waterbury, and local shopping, dining, and parks just minutes from your front door.

Schedule Your Tour Today!

desc: Thank you for your interest in The Regency! You can read about us below, or for a good look, you can visit us at our website, www. fountainheadpm1 . com. To make budgeting even easier, your heat, hot water and cooking gas are included in your monthly rent payment. For your convenience, we accept most common forms of payment, including credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, Discover and American Express). We offer our residents a terrific living experience with spacious apartments and fully equipped kitchens, including full-size microwaves and dishwashers. Our stoves are gas-burning and self-cleaning, making your cooking experience quick and easy. We provide ample closet space for all your clothing and belongings to keep them neat and organized. When you are ready to do laundry, we provide modern internet-connected laundry rooms for your use, equipped with updated professionally-maintained high-capacity machines. When your laundry cycle is finished, get a notification on your phone that its ready to go. You can also check machine availability through the convenience of QR codes. When your family and friends come to visit, you can speak with them with the two-way intercom system and unlock the building front entry door from the convenience of your apartment. Every unit will get an assigned parking space for your use in our well lit, off-street parking lot. We have a loading/unloading ramp for your use to move things in/out of the building easier. With our two elevators, grocery trips and shopping bags will be easily and quickly brought to your apartment. Our building offers 87 digital surveillance cameras that ensure your pathway is recorded 24/7 right to your apartment door. We are a pet friendly building and offer a welcome and friendly home for your pets that are approved by us!

desc:
Crestview Estates Modern Living in West Haven

Welcome to Crestview Estates, a beautifully modernized community designed for comfort, convenience, and style. Every apartment has been thoughtfully renovated with brand new flooring, plush bedroom carpeting, updated kitchens with modern appliances, and sleek, finished bathrooms. Large windows fill each home with natural light, while the generous closet space, including walk-in options, ensures plenty of room for storage.

Apartment Features:
	 Completely renovated interiors
Brand new flooring throughout
	 Plush carpeted bedrooms
	 Modern finished bathrooms
	 Updated kitchens with modern appliances
	 Abundant closet space, including walk-in closets
	 Large windows for natural light

Community Amenities:
	 	 Well-maintained building and grounds
	 	 Three laundry rooms for your convenience
	 	 Brand new, state-of-the-art elevator
	 	 Gorgeous pool with relaxing sitting area
	 EV chargers and a large parking lot
	 Upgraded security camera system
	 On-site superintendent for peace of mind

Prime Location:
Perfectly located within walking distance to the University of New Haven, as well as nearby coffee shops, restaurants, and local stores.

We take tremendous pride in Crestview Estates and look forward to bringing exciting additions in the near future. Please reach out we are excited to work with you!

desc:
Live the Life You've Always Imagined Without Sacrificing Style or Quality

At Thompson Luxury Residences, every apartment is thoughtfully designed to reflect your lifestyle. Now you truly can have it all comfort, sophistication, and a curated living experience, all in one place.

Each residence features a unique layout, perfect for entertaining. Spacious alcove living areas allow for seamless integration of dining and lounge spaces, creating a natural flow for hosting guests. Oversized industrial black aluminum windows flood every apartment with natural light, enhancing both style and livability.

Modern Finishes with Timeless Appeal

The development team has crafted each residence to offer a clean, modern aesthetic with a distinctive edge. Wide-plank, grey-toned oak veneer flooring stretches throughout the apartments, setting a sleek foundation for your home.

The living areas are highlighted by expansive, wall-to-wall windows that invite light and openness. Kitchens are outfitted with custom white shaker cabinetry and matching bathroom vanities, delivering a cohesive design throughout. Oversized kitchen islands feature dramatic Calacatta waterfall-edge countertops, complete with in-island cooktops, overhead range hoods, and extended overhangs for casual dining. Each unit includes premium stainless steel appliances including dishwashers and matte black faucets for a bold, contemporary finish.

Elegant, Spa-Inspired Bathrooms

Bathrooms are appointed with luxurious Italian porcelain tile Vega Blanco and Parchment by Marazzi and custom vanities topped with Calacatta counters. Sleek stainless steel fixtures and modern, anti-fog LED backlit mirrors with a radius edge add a final touch of sophistication.

desc:
Taunton Woods is a unique property located in charming Newtown, CT. Once home to the well-known publishing company Taunton Press, the property is set on 13 acres of idyllic New England woodland, complete with walking trails, a sparkling brook, and a variety of outdoor amenities. Residents can choose from Studio, 1-Bedroom, 1-Bedroom plus den, or 2-Bedroom apartment homes, all complete with premium finishes while enjoying the best indoor and outdoor amenities in the area.

Residents will enjoy this natural wooded sanctuary, which includes the convenience of its ideal location - with easy access to I-84 for commuters and nearby local destinations and amenities within minutes of the property, including Newtown Country Club, Ferris Acres Farm, Fairfield Hills, Historic Main Street, Everwonder Children's Museum, Paugussett State Forest, popular breweries, vineyards and restaurants, grocery and retail, and much more.

Schedule a tour to be the first to receive updates and information about availability.

desc:
Welcome to City Crossing, a vibrant new residential community just one block south of New Haven's lively downtown, next to Yale School of Medicine and steps to Yale New Haven Hospital. This neighborhood features five mid-rise apartment buildings with over 600 luxury apartments, thoughtfully designed to fit your busy lifestyle and enhance your well-being. City Crossing provides flexible living solutions for those seeking stays as short as one month.

Each building has its own personality, and come with shared amenities like rooftop terraces, fireside lounges, and comfortable co-working spaces that bring the entire community together. You'll find outdoor rooftop spaces with water views, 24-hour fitness centers, a private yoga studio, rooftop pool, and a salt meditation room designed to help you recharge and resetalong with spacious apartments featuring high ceilings, walk-in closets, and stylish finishes that make it easy to feel at home, whether you're staying short-term or settling in longer.

Craft Your Life. New Haven apartments created with history, character and passion. At the intersection of past and present, a genuine craft is evident in every element of Winchester Lofts. From the century-old brick walls to exposed timber ceilings, it's the feeling of authenticity you get when you step into your apartment. The artistry of the past is embraced in the immaculately restored building and is ideally suited for modern New Haven living.

desc:
The Ultimate New Haven Location!

Crown Street is known in New Haven as the center of it all, close to everything, with many dining options, theaters, museums, amazing music venues, and more. With the addition of Metro Star's standout property, Metro on Crown, this downtown location has become the distinctive architectural community you must experience. Several buildings on the best block in New Haven, each one has their own unique style. Secured and gated with finely-appointed amenities, these apartments are sure to please the most discriminating renter.

Metro on Crown is an easy walk for those working in the surrounding area for employers such as Yale-New Haven Health System, Smilow Cancer Hospital, Yale University, and Bio-tech companies, like Alexion. The Crown Street neighborhood provides the perfect balance between Yale and New Haven. This location is fully integrated with the best things New Haven has to offer. You'll be steps away from the Old Campus, the birthplace of the hamburger at Louis Lunch, a slice of mashed potato and bacon pizza at BAR, and a plethora of cuisines to choose from.

Inquire today! Metro Star's exceptional customer service is ready to serve you. We have several options to choose from with spacious and bright open floor plans. Don't miss out! Call today for a private tour.

Eli Whitney Apartments at 750 Whitney Avenue in East Rock offers a blend of classic charm and modern convenience. Whether commuting to campus or enjoying local events like the Arts & Ideas Festival, this community provides both lifestyle and location in one of New Haven's best neighborhoods.

desc: Welcome to Cadence on Canal where the Farmington Canal Heritage Trail lies just beyond your doorstep, and quiet, thoughtful living becomes your foundation. Whether you're diving into work, finding space to think, admiring the local art that surrounds you, or simply breathing in morning air, your home becomes your sanctuary. And when you're ready to explore, boutique restaurants, cultural hubs, Yale University and city life await all within an easy walk or ride.

desc: Welcome to Axis 201, where doers, innovators and achievers are effortlessly linked with each other and with the exciting city of New Haven. Reaching Science Park, Yale, or downtown is a breeze and the Farmington Canal Greenway, city eateries and hot spots are right outside your door.Come home to brand new apartments with modern finishes that make for exceptional living while enjoying time with neighbors and friends thanks to next-level amenities. Relax by the pool, work out stress in the revolutionary fitness center, focus on business in our on-site private work pods, and unplug in the clubhouse or around the firepit at the end of a long day.These options are yours and they're right within reach. Explore how easy life can be at Axis 201.

Don't miss the opportunity to make 451 Orange St #3R your next home.
